splink_merge_weight.rule: lowest match weight on the grid with dev Splink auto-merge precision >= target; none -> no Splink auto-merge

ai_merge.rule: lowest value on the grid with dev cascade auto-merge precision >= target

ai_nonmatch.rule: highest value on the grid such that dev true pairs at or below it <= share of all dev true pairs

cutoff_selection_on_dev.routing: Splink match weight >= cutoff -> auto-merge; every other blocked candidate -> AI judge (mean of non-missing repeats); both repeats missing -> review

verdict_rules.PASS: all nine criteria pass on test seed 202
verdict_rules.invalid: if 1, 2, 7 or 9 fails the run is invalid and no accuracy claim is published
verdict_rules.honest_negative: if 5 fails, the negative result is published as-is
verdict_rules.disguised_names: a recall drop above 0.25 is flagged, not a kill
